description:
Get personalized fragrance recommendations based on your taste profile. Optional natural-language prompt to guide results (e.g. 'something fresh for summer'). Requires Pro.

See also: `ai_wear_today` for what to wear right now · `user_get_cabinet` for your collection.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

prompt.description: Optional natural-language guidance, e.g. 'fresh for summer office'

name: ai_recommend
